title: Pakistan chaos: PCB seeks answers over Rizwan, Imam picks as Misbah quits committee
content: Pakistan Cricket Board seeks explanation from its selection committee.  The board questioned the rationale behind including Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq.  This action follows the team's poor performance in the ongoing England Test series.  Several players and coaching staff have been released and replaced amid this overhaul.  Misbah-ul-Haq is reportedly set to resign from the selection committee.

title: Nepal floods bring 'unusual' fish to Bihar, govt warns people not to eat or sell them
content: In light of recent floods from Nepal, the Bihar government has issued a warning about the presence of strange fish species in the Gandak river. Residents are advised to avoid consuming or selling these unidentified fish until their safety can be verified. Among these is the goonch catfish, locally called Gochita. Anyone who falls ill after eating these fish is urged to seek medical assistance promptly.

title: Oracle layoffs: The 6 am email didn't come, so employees are counting Slack members
content: Oracle layoffs 2026: The dreaded 6 am layoff email did not arrive on September 1, leaving employees across the US and India tracking Slack member counts and trading rumours of a September 15 date. Managers were asked to list affected staff before Oracle's second fiscal quarter began. After 21,000 job cuts, $55.7 billion in AI data centre spending and $1.8 billion in restructuring charges, Oracle staff are still waiting.

title: Vice-captain Sooryavanshi shines as East beat Central to reach Duleep Trophy final
content: East Zone secured a place in the Duleep Trophy final with a four-wicket victory over Central Zone. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's aggressive cameo provided crucial momentum during the chase for East Zone. Mohammed Shami and Mukesh Kumar delivered fiery spells to dismantle Central Zone's batting lineup. Mukesh was named Player of the Match for his outstanding seven-wicket haul in the semifinal.

title: Mark Zuckerberg buys 440-acre Irish castle estate; spokesperson says family is ‘excited’
content: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have acquired the impressive Strancally Castle, a historic estate sprawling over 440 acres in County Waterford, Ireland. They intend to use this majestic castle as a residence during their trips to Ireland, reinforcing Meta's strong ties to the country where its international headquarters are situated.

title: Maharashtra puts FDA action against loose edible oil sales on hold for 1 year
content: Maharashtra's chief minister has deferred enforcement action on loose edible oil sales for one year.  Traders must comply with the law after this mandatory transition period ends.  Joint committees will guide traditional traders in making necessary business practice changes.  The government will assist businesses with facilities and potential subsidies for compliance.  This decision balances public health concerns with the livelihoods of many traders.

title: Meet Ingrid Alexandra, 22, who could become Norway's first queen in 600 years
content: Crown Princess Ingrid Alexandra, 22, has stepped into a historic new role as heir to Norway’s throne following King Haakon’s accession. As Haakon takes his constitutional oath, Ingrid Alexandra becomes the country’s first adult heir at the time of succession in modern history. If she becomes monarch, she could be Norway’s first reigning queen in over 600 years.

title: More than 40 Tennessee tiny home owners seek $5m in HOA lawsuit
content: More than 40 homeowners in Tennessee’s Sunset Bluff community have joined a $5 million lawsuit against developer Claude “Chip” Hayes III, accusing him of retaining control of their HOAs and mismanaging funds. Residents allege that nearly 80% of one HOA’s budget went to a lawn care company owned by Hayes, while several promised amenities remain unfinished.

title: Grasshoppers, flowers, ramen to umbrellas: Why Japan has vending machines for everything
content: Japan has an impressive count of more than 2.6 million vending machines, providing a vast array of products for all kinds of consumers. Each machine is powered by advanced embedded computer systems that enhance the efficiency of product dispensing. Sophisticated sensors validate payments through coins or banknotes, while various mechanical methods ensure that products are delivered carefully. Additionally, dual-temperature machines serve both hot and cold beverages seamlessly.

title: Operation ‘Rotten Apple’: US arrests over 2,100 illegal immigrants across New York
content: During a comprehensive operation aimed at reinforcing public safety, US Immigration and Customs Enforcement detained 2,197 undocumented individuals throughout New York. Many of those arrested had serious criminal records. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin emphasized that the operation was crucial for enhancing safety in the state while criticizing local officials for their lack of cooperation with federal agencies.

title: India's GDP grows 7.8% in Q1: Factors powering the economy despite global turmoil
content: In the first quarter, India showcased impressive economic resilience with a remarkable 7.8% GDP growth. The surge was notably driven by a surge in domestic demand and the services sector. Additionally, investment activity picked up pace, enhancing the overall economic landscape. This achievement stands out amid global geopolitical tensions and market fluctuations, reinforcing India's status as the fastest-growing major economy in the world.

title: Crumbling 1979 Michigan dome bought for $87,000 now lists for $499,900
content: In Brighton, Michigan, a remarkable transformation has taken place with a once-neglected 1970s concrete dome home. Acquired in 2023 for $87,000, this property underwent a meticulous renovation, now boasting four bedrooms infused with modern luxury and eco-friendly features. Now on the market for $499,900, its unique design and energy-efficient qualities are captivating buyers in search of distinctive living spaces.

title: Emma Jarman met Dolly Parton as a newborn; 18 years later, she shares the story
content: Eighteen-year-old Emma Jarman recalls meeting Dolly Parton when she was just one day old at Rotherham Hospital in 2007. The singer had visited the UK to launch her Imagination Library literacy initiative, with Emma becoming its first UK recipient. Emma now reflects on their surreal encounter and Parton’s lasting impact on her life.

title: Rs 25,000 salary to Rs 1 cr EPF corpus: Compounding math can make you crorepati
content: Over time, the interest earned on the accumulated balance earns interest, allowing compounding to steadily increase your retirement savings. With regular contributions maintained over a long period, an employee can potentially build an EPF corpus of Rs 1 crore or more.

title: ‘Hope is still alive’: Krunal reacts after missing out on India’s Afghan T20I squad
content: Krunal Pandya remains optimistic about his potential return to international cricket after his absence in the Afghanistan T20I series. Jasprit Bumrah is set to rejoin the team, contingent on a positive fitness assessment concerning his knee injury. Additionally, several players, including Nitish Kumar Reddy, are included pending their fitness. Hardik Pandya, however, will not participate due to a leg issue affecting his comeback strategy.

title: The Rs 2.05 crore question: Can Meta be blamed for what its glasses record?

title: Asian Games cricket row: Japan Cricket CEO says teams can make own arrangements
content: Japan Cricket CEO Naoki Alex Miyaji clarified Asian Games accommodation arrangements for teams.  Participating teams are offered hotel stays and can arrange their own lodging.  Logistical constraints are affecting many sports, not just cricket at the event.  The Korogi Sports Park venue was built from scratch within a tight timeframe.  Organisers are confident cricket will make a strong impression at the Games.

title: MPSC exam paper leak: ‘Top ranker’ arrested, intentionally gave 10 wrong answers
content: Mumbai Police arrested a top-ranking MPSC candidate in the drug inspector exam leak case.  This arrest brings the total number of accused individuals to seven now.  Police allege the candidate received the leaked paper and answered questions incorrectly.  The MPSC had previously cancelled the recruitment process due to the alleged breach.  A fresh examination will now be conducted to ensure fairness for all.

title: Polish priest survived Nazi malaria experiments, then built Nebraska shrine
content: Father Henry J. Denis emerged from the horrors of Dachau concentration camp and the inhumane medical experiments conducted there. With a steadfast vow to create a shrine to Mary if he survived, he eventually settled in Nebraska, where he honored that promise. The Our Lady of Fatima Shrine, dedicated in August 1956, serves as a powerful symbol of hope and unwavering faith transcending time and geography.

title: Boston teen, 19, dies after jumping onto train tracks to save girlfriend
content: A nineteen-year-old man lost his life in a tragic act of courage while on his first subway journey. He leaped onto the tracks after his girlfriend stumbled, attempting to save her. Unfortunately, he came into contact with the electric third rail. Now in critical condition, his girlfriend is hospitalized, spurring urgent calls for better safety measures on subway platforms.

title: ‘May land me in hot water’: Multan Sultans CEO delivers explosive take on Pak cricket
content: Pakistan Cricket Board's recent squad and coaching changes have drawn significant criticism.  Multan Sultans CEO Gohar Shah voiced concerns over player professionalism and team intensity.  He also highlighted issues within the wider cricket ecosystem, including media and former players.  Shah pointed to bureaucratic hurdles and a lack of incentive for PCB stakeholders.  His assessment offered a candid view on the state of Pakistan cricket.

title: Pankaj Bhadouria shares ‘Cancer’ changed her; says 'Was weakened by infections'
content: MasterChef India champion Pankaj Bhadouria has bravely opened up about her ongoing battle with breast cancer. Faced with serious health challenges this August, including painful infections and the emotional toll of hair loss, she has leaned on the love of family and friends. A recent outing with her loved ones symbolizes her resilience and progress, as Pankaj continues to embrace life with optimism and support despite the circumstances.

title: Kerala Teen's Viral Resemblance: Allen James dubbed Kerala's Yamal; hopes for Yamal message
content: A teenager from Kerala, Allen James, has captured the internet's attention with his remarkable likeness to football player Lamine Yamal. A video showcasing his talent has gone viral, racking up millions of views across various social media sites. As a defender with a passion for football, Allen idolizes Lionel Messi and proudly supports Argentina.

title: UPI gets festive boost: Digital payments hit a record 24.51 bn transactions in August
content: In August, Unified Payments Interface hit an all-time high for monthly transaction volumes, largely fueled by festive celebrations like Raksha Bandhan that encouraged peer-to-peer transfers. As transaction values approached previous peaks, the digital payment landscape continued to evolve, with UPI now being embraced in eleven countries worldwide. The potential for further growth is promising as innovative use cases, such as credit options within UPI, start to gain traction.

title: Australian home prices extend decline as inflation, rate fears weigh
content: Australian home prices dropped for a fifth month in August. Sydney and Melbourne saw significant declines, now seven percent below peaks. Higher borrowing costs and inflation are squeezing buyer demand across the nation. Analysts predict further price falls, potentially reaching ten percent from their highest points. This housing slowdown impacts economic growth and consumer spending significantly.

title: ‘I felt great’: Alcaraz makes stunning US Open return after 139 days out with injury
content: Carlos Alcaraz returned to tennis after a long injury layoff. He played his first match in 139 days at the US Open. Alcaraz secured a convincing victory against Roman Safiullin in straight sets. The young Spaniard confirmed he was playing pain-free and felt great. He expressed happiness and a desire to enjoy every match.

title: 'We can resist US unilateralism': Iran president tells Putin on sidelines of SCO summit
content: During a recent dialogue, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian expressed gratitude towards Vladimir Putin for Russia's supportive position. He emphasized the need for Iran and Russia to jointly counter the unilateral actions of the United States. Pezeshkian also condemned the U.S. for its sanctions and breaches of international law. Putin, in response, endorsed the memorandum aimed at fostering cooperation between Iran and Russia amidst escalating tensions with the U.S.

title: Missiles from anywhere? Japan’s new warship is built to spot them all
content: Japan is constructing advanced missile-defence warships equipped with powerful radar systems. These new vessels will utilize the AN/SPY-7 radar for enhanced threat detection capabilities. The program aims to counter growing missile threats from North Korea and the wider region. These ships are scheduled to enter service in fiscal 2027 and 2028. Japan is enhancing its defense network to address evolving regional security challenges.

title: NEET protest FIRs quashed: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke calls SC move ‘absolute justice’
content: The Supreme Court's recent verdict has annulled all FIRs filed against students engaged in protests related to NEET across the country. This notable decision serves justice to the protesting individuals and their grieving families. Moreover, it mandates the government to offer compensation to the relatives of those who tragically took their own lives. CJP's Abhijeet Dipke heralded this ruling as essential justice for all participants.

title: Bumrah, Samson back; Pandya misses out as India announce squad for Afghanistan T20Is
content: The Indian cricket team has officially unveiled their 15-member squad for the T20I series against Afghanistan, with Shreyas Iyer as captain and Tilak Varma as vice-captain. The pace attack is bolstered by the return of Jasprit Bumrah, alongside Arshdeep Singh and Harshit Rana. Notable batsmen include Sanju Samson and Ishan Kishan, although some players still await fitness clearance prior to the series start.

title: Closed for decades, Pittsburgh's 102-foot lookout is being restored for $3m
content: The historic North Park Observation Tower in Pittsburgh is poised to reopen its doors after being closed for years. A comprehensive restoration effort is underway, focusing on the beloved 1937 building and its staircase, while also enhancing the surrounding park area with fresh landscaping and improved accessibility. Funded by a mix of public and private investments, the landmark is anticipated to welcome guests once more by 2027.

title: Meet Jasmyn Blackburn, the kindergarten teacher making dopamine dressing a hit
content: Jasmyn Blackburn, a kindergarten teacher, uses colorful and sparkly clothing to inspire her young students.  She believes in 'dopamine dressing,' which means wearing clothes that bring happiness.  Her unique style has gained a significant following on social media platforms.  Blackburn's wardrobe features many school-themed items, reflecting her passion for teaching.  She encourages others to find joy in their personal style and express themselves.

title: Heavy rain causes cave-in on Ganga Expressway ramp, carpet used as quick fix
content: A Ganga Expressway ramp in Unnao experienced a cave-in after heavy rainfall on Tuesday. Workers temporarily covered the damaged section to divert gushing rainwater effectively. The concessionaire and contractor swiftly repaired the affected portion within two and a half hours. Continuous rain also caused waterlogging at the nearby toll plaza on the expressway. Long-term measures are planned to prevent future waterlogging issues at the toll booths.

title: $4 million diamond necklace stolen in daylight heist at Vienna museum

title: Israeli PM Netanyahu’s son urgently evacuated from US over ‘significant threat’

title: Rs 100 Crore Defamation Suit: HC to hear plea on Dhoni deposition; venue of recording in focus
content: the issue pertains to a defamation suit filed by IPS officer in 2014 . the suit was filed against the officer and media houses for linking him in the 2013 IPL betting scam . he cannot be made to face deposition for deposition made in his official name .

title: US military strikes Iran over 'attempted' shipping attacks as tensions flare
content: the strike is in retaliation for what he described as Iran's "failed attempt" to add sea mines to the Strait of Hormuz . eight missiles were all intercepted at a US military base in Jordan .

title: Sudhikaran row: BJP SC Morcha performs ‘buddhi-shuddhi’ ritual for Rahul Gandhi
content: BJP Scheduled Caste Morcha performed a 'buddhi-shuddhai' ritual for Congress leader Rahul Gandhi . the alleged 'purification' ritual was conducted after the rally in Haldwani last month .

title: Data Darbar: Trump backs server farm boom as protests grow in US
content: embracing data centers would mean jobs, lower taxes and prosperity . he warned that communities which reject data centers will end up “backwards and poor” echoes of which are now being heard in India too . the only reason that communities across the u.s. should not want data centers is if they want to end up being poor .

title: Nepal floods: Indian team starts DNA analysis, death toll reaches 1,050 - what we know
content: the 19-member Indian Forensic Team began DNA sample analysis in collaboration with their Nepali counterparts . the effort comes as authorities deal with a large number of recovered bodies and thousands of people still unaccounted for . nearly 4,000 people, including 583 foreigners, are missing .

title: Watch: CM Vijay steps out of convoy, gifts elderly woman his Dior glasses
content: vijay was in Salem to open the gates of the Mettur Dam and release water for Samba cultivation in the Cauvery Delta . after inspecting the hydroelectric power station, he made an unscheduled stop at a roadside farm while travelling towards Salem airport .
